definitions.name: 项目质量状态
definitions.primary_summary: overall_quality at matched observed completion; fixed-horizon state separately
definitions.validity: Require an actual construction update. Initial defaults are not outcomes. defect_rate is 1-overall_quality, not independent evidence.

definitions.name: 施工风险暴露
definitions.validity: Construction-stage state events after the first real progress update, preserving event order. No construction means N/A, not zero. Not calibrated probabilities.

definitions.name: 完工与结算状态
definitions.unit: binary per complete chain, project-aggregated rates
definitions.denominator: 3 planned replicate blocks per project per arm, unknown chain endpoints separately disclosed
definitions.validity: Complete fixed observation horizon required for false; technical interruption means unknown. No extension of observation horizon per arm.

definitions.name: 业务扰动事件
definitions.exposure: construction_progress_updated count and valid construction window alongside counts
definitions.validity: Use project event_log only, filtered by project_id and deduplicated by event_id. Missing log is not zero; no construction is not comparative improvement.
